content.text:
[tool.poetry]

name = "dcat-catalog-check"
version = "1.1.0"
description = "DCAT Catalog Check"
authors = [
  "Jesper Zedlitz <jesper.zedlitz@stk.landsh.de>",
  "Thorge Petersen <petersen@rz.uni-kiel.de>",
]
license = "AGPL-3.0-or-later"
readme = "README.md"

[tool.poetry.dependencies]
python = "^3.10"
requests = "^2.32.3"
python-magic = "^0.4.27"
frictionless = {extras = ["wkt"], version = "^5.18.1"}
geopandas = "^1.0.1"
rdflib = "^7.1.1"
pypdf = "^5.1.0"
pillow = "^11.0.0"
fiona = "^1.10.1"
pyarrow = "^18.1.0"
geojson = "^3.2.0"
gdal = "3.6.2"

[tool.poetry.group.dev.dependencies]
coverage = "^7.6.1"
ruff = "^0.6.8"

[build-system]
requires = ["poetry-core"]
build-backend = "poetry.core.masonry.api"
---
FROM python:3.10

# Install necessary system dependencies
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y \
    libgdal-dev \
    libmagic-dev \
    gcc \
    python3-dev \
    musl-dev \
    libgeos-dev \
    libproj-dev \
    python3-poetry

# Set the working directory inside the container
WORKDIR /app

# Copy the entire project to the container's working directory
COPY . .

# Install project dependencies with Poetry
RUN poetry install --no-interaction --no-ansi

# Make the main script executable
RUN chmod +x dcat_catalog_check.py

# Specify the entry point to run the script by default
ENTRYPOINT ["poetry", "run", "./dcat_catalog_check.py"]
---
formats/:
__init__.py
atom_format.py
docx_format.py
geojson_format.py
geotiff_format.py
gml_format.py
jpeg_format.py
json_format.py
ods_format.py
odt_format.py
parquet_format.py
pdf_format.py
png_format.py
rdf_format.py
shp_format.py
wfs_srvc_format.py
wms_srvc_format.py
wmts_srvc_format.py
xlsx_format.py
xml_format.py
zip_format.py

resources/:
file_types.json

tests/:
__init__.py
data
test_all_formats.py
test_atom_format.py
test_dcat_catalog_check.py
test_docx_format.py
test_geojson_format.py
test_geotiff_format.py
test_gml_format.py
test_integration.py
test_jpeg_format.py
test_json_format.py
test_ods_format.py
test_odt_format.py
test_parquet_format.py
test_pdf_format.py
test_png_format.py
test_rdf_format.py
test_shp_format.py
test_wmts_format.py
test_xlsx_format.py
test_xml_format.py
test_zip_format.py

tools/:
generate_report.py
jsonl2sqlite.py
per_publisher.py

observation.command: cat pyproject.toml && echo "---" && cat Dockerfile && echo "---" && ls resources/ formats/ tests/ tools/
